SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE District = 'Alameda County Office of Education' 
  AND StatusType = 'Merged' 
  AND NCESSchool IN (
    SELECT NCESSchool 
    FROM satscores 
    WHERE NumTstTakr < 100
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE District = 'Alameda County Office of Education' 
AND StatusType = 'Merged' 
AND NCESSchool IN (
    SELECT NCESSchool 
    FROM satscores 
    GROUP BY NCESSchool 
    HAVING SUM(NumTstTakr) < 100
);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.County = 'Alameda' AND schools.StatusType = 'Merged' AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100;
